cards.title: Wildwood walls
cards.text: 3 wall looks, each with two doors set in it, a corner and a hero for size. Tick the one you want.
cards.why: The walls are now taller than the doors: each door sits in its own frame in the wall, and the wall rises above it. Every picture is the game's real floor and doors at game scale.

items.label: Root bank
items.text: A bank of packed earth held together by thick tree roots, with bushes along its top.

items.label: Log palisade
items.text: A stockade of standing logs lashed with rope, their cut ends showing along the top; a crossbeam over each door.

items.label: Mossy drystone
items.text: Round fieldstones stacked dry, moss on their tops and ferns along the wall; a great flat lintel over each door.

items.label: Shored tunnel
items.text: Dug earth held up by thick timber posts, boards and a heavy top beam with iron brackets; lanterns hang here and there.

items.label: Junk stockade
items.text: Goblin work: odd planks nailed every which way, an iron band, sharpened stakes along the top, shields hung up.

items.label: Sewer brick
items.text: Old red brick on a green stone footing, moss and slime running down it; brick arches over the doors.

items.label: Pipe wall
items.text: Green stone blocks carrying two big copper pipes, flanged and bolted, valve wheels and gauges here and there.

items.label: Glazed tile
items.text: The city's old tiled tunnels: pale green glazed tiles, a dark green band, grime creeping up from the foot.

items.label: Tomb ashlar
items.text: Big grey cut blocks in courses on a plinth, a string course, burial niches with a skull now and then.

items.label: Ossuary
items.text: Stone bands with rows of skulls and stacked long bones set between them; a hood of skulls over each door.

items.label: Blind arcade
items.text: A row of tall pointed arches sunk into the stone, dark inside, a string course over them; candles in some.

items.label: Ice blocks
items.text: Big glassy blocks of blue ice, snow heaped along the top and icicles hanging down; an ice arch over each door.

items.label: Frosted rock
items.text: Dark blue-grey rock with white rime on every stone, snow along the top and long icicles; a stone lintel heavy with snow.

items.label: Crystal ridge
items.text: Packed snow and ice in blue bands, topped with a ridge of big ice crystals; crystals crown each door.

items.label: Basalt columns
items.text: Black basalt in tall six-sided columns, their tops showing along the wall; lava glowing in the cracks at the foot.

items.label: Hell brick
items.text: Dark red brick with fire glowing in the joints near the floor, an iron cap set with spikes; horned skulls over the doors.

items.label: Marble and gold
items.text: White marble panels framed in gold, a gold plinth and frieze; a sun of gold above each door.

items.label: Gilded colonnade
items.text: White fluted columns with gold heads and feet, deep violet between them set with gold stars; a gold pediment over each door.

items.label: Sandstone
items.text: Warm cut sandstone with a carved band of signs, sand drifted against its foot and along its top; a winged sun over each door.

items.label: Painted tomb
items.text: Smooth plaster painted in teal, red and gold bands under a curved cornice; tapered frames and a sun disc at each door.

items.label: Riveted plates
items.text: Steel plates riveted at the seams on a brass plinth, a warning stripe at the foot; gear-headed brass hoods over the doors.

items.label: Brass pipeworks
items.text: Fire brick below, brass pipes, valves and gauges above, a big pipe along the top; pipes arch over each door.
